title: The guard refuses a push that moves a branch another worktree has checked out
why: Lane review-record-post-check (session_013NEJKzmHFbqZ9QC2TAupBc, #2219), relayed by the coordinator 13:49 CST Nov 8: a test-author agent pushed to a branch that the lane's own worktree had checked out, and that worktree was left with a stale index. Step one-worktree-per-branch (#1583) refuses only `git checkout -B` or `switch -C` of a held branch, not a push that moves one. The harm is the same: a later commit from the stale index silently undoes pushed work.
note: Sighting (lane sim-tool-lease-check, via coordinator 13:55 CST Nov 8): its brief sent an agent to a branch the lane's own worktree held.
